title: Credential-Carried Institutional Encounter
architecture_reference: SILT Core v0.2 Semantic Architecture - Freeze Candidate 1 (derived from RC4.1 pre-freeze stress-test revision)
purpose: Test whether a credential can carry Evidence concerning Standing without becoming Source, Standing or Authority.
pressure_test: Cryptographic validity must not manufacture relational validity.

encounter.context: P Presents an institutional credential to R in support of a claimed institutional Standing and proposed Action.

sources.description: Institutional relationship or appointment grounding the claimed Standing.

presentations.purpose: Present current institutional Standing and, where required, Authority for ACT-02.

authorities.description: Claimed bounded Authority for ACT-02 in the institutional encounter.

conditions.description: Relevant institutional Standing is current for this encounter.
Where ACT-02 requires Authority, current Authority is established.

rules: Cryptographic credential validity alone is insufficient to establish current Standing or Authority unless expressly made sufficient.

expected_evaluations.reason: The base case establishes that P's institutional Standing remains current.
The base case separately establishes the required Authority for ACT-02.

variants.title: Stale semantic relation
variants.description: VC-01 remains cryptographically valid after the underlying institutional appointment or recognition has ended.

expected_evaluations.reason: The underlying institutional Standing is known not to be current despite valid credential cryptography.

variants.title: Current credential, unresolved current recognition
variants.description: VC-01 verifies, but the supplied state does not establish whether P's recognition remains current.

expected_evaluations.reason: Current recognition cannot be concluded without importing a missing fact.

variants.title: Key rotation
variants.description: P rotates keys while the institutional relationship remains unchanged.

must_preserve.statement: Semantic Standing may persist through key rotation.

variants.title: Credential proves affiliation, not Action Authority
variants.description: The credential sufficiently supports Standing but does not resolve Authority for ACT-02.

expected_evaluations.reason: The affiliation evidence is sufficient for Standing.
The credential does not establish whether P holds Authority for ACT-02.

must_preserve.statement: Issuer is not automatically a universal Source of legitimacy.
Key control is distinct from Authority.
Cryptographic continuity is distinct from semantic continuity.

must_not_infer.statement: A valid credential implies current Standing.
A trusted issuer implies universal legitimacy.
Institutional affiliation implies Authority for every Action.

fixture_verdict: No missing Core primitive exposed. The fixture depends on preserving Evidence, Standing, Authority and cryptographic/semantic continuity as distinct.
